text_annotations.text:
SHS-Z2M-Presence v2.0
ESP32-C6-WROOM-1-N8 Standalone
Dual mmWave Zigbee Sensor

UART assignments (firmware-compatible with v1):
IO4 = UART1_TX → LD2410C RX
IO5 = UART1_RX ← LD2410C TX
IO18 = UART0_TX → LD2450 RX
IO19 = UART0_RX ← LD2450 TX
IO12/IO13 = USB D-/D+ (native USB)

Power: VBUS(5V) → AP2112K → 3.3V
U2/U3 radar modules on +5V direct
U1 ESP32 on +3.3V (LDO output)
CC1/CC2: 5.1k pull-down for USB-C 5V source
C9 22uF bulk cap on VBUS (Espressif ref schematic)

LEDs:
LED1 (green) = Status/Zigbee via IO2 + R5 330R
